title: Salah insights, daily notes, and unified calendar exports
summary: Upgraded Salah Tracker to distinguish Completed, Missed, and Not logged for every obligatory prayer, with period-based per-prayer rates, verified streaks, logged-day coverage, improvement comparisons, complete-day context, weekday patterns, and completion trends. Optional Sunnahs remain separate from obligatory statistics.

Added private daily notes to each tracker date. Notes stay with the local Salah record and are included in Backup and Restore without affecting obligatory totals, rates, streaks, or Share Your Defaults.

Moved the opt-in Salah review reminder into Settings beside optional fixed-time Isha and Friday Jumu’ah calendar items. The privacy-safe event contains no prayer history, the preference stays local, and calendar apps control alert delivery.

Unified active Settings, City Mode, standalone Iqama Times, Deep Search Athan, and Masjid Mode exports behind one calendar serializer and download path. Masjid Mode can now export the selected profile's Iqama rules and Friday Jumu’ah slots using its linked City Mode Athan source or the clearly disclosed current-device fallback.

title: Private sharing and daily preferences
summary: Added Share Your Defaults beside Share App. Shared links use a strict allowlist for prayer calculation, language, clock format, optional Sunnahs visibility, and reminder defaults; recipients review the contents before applying them, while Salah and Ramadan records, Quran activity, locations, saved profiles, and other personal data remain excluded.

Added explicit Share City Profile and Share Masjid Profile actions inside the selected profile. City shares identify the location and calculation configuration without embedding imported yearly timetable rows, while Masjid shares include the selected address or location note, Iqama rules, Jumu’ah slots, and notes with an on-screen review warning.

Renamed Language and layout to Preferences, added device-default, AM/PM, and 24-hour clock choices across the app, and added an optional Sunnahs tile that never changes the five obligatory-prayer completion total. Home now treats Sunrise as the state after Fajr and refreshes its prayer window while open.

title: Dedicated Android Qibla compass engine
summary: Rebuilt Android Qibla heading detection as a separate engine that prefers the Absolute Orientation Sensor, converts its screen-frame quaternion into a true heading, and uses only strictly absolute device-orientation events as a fallback.

Added source locking, circular smoothing, spike damping, screen-rotation compensation, and regression tests so relative readings cannot redefine the phone's current direction as North. The established iPhone compass path and the Qibla interface remain unchanged.
Updated Settings to offer installation only through a real browser-provided PWA prompt, with manual Add to Home Screen guidance when required. Credits now keeps only the Share App action.

title: Reliable Android Qibla headings
summary: Fixed inconsistent Android Qibla headings by listening for Earth-referenced absolute device orientation instead of treating each browser session's relative motion angle as North.
Preserved the dedicated iPhone compass path, added heading-source diagnostics, and now rejects relative-only readings so alignment guidance and haptics cannot be triggered by a false compass heading.

Added cross-platform heading regression tests, expanded Qibla troubleshooting guidance, and refreshed the README to document the unified navy-and-teal interface, three-tab navigation, More tools, and shared primary prayer source.

title: CSV and JSON timetable imports
summary: Expanded City Mode yearly timetable imports to support CSV and JSON alongside Excel .xlsx files, using the same local-only validation and prayer-source pipeline.

CSV supports quoted fields and the standard Date, Fajr, Sunrise, Dhuhr/Zuhar, Asr, Maghrib, and Isha columns. JSON supports dated prayer-record arrays or Athan PWA's recurring month-day timetable structure, with optional location and coordinate metadata.
Updated the timetable picker, Help instructions, AI conversion prompt, tests, and release information for all three supported formats.

title: Primary prayer sources and local timetable imports
summary: Renamed Home prayer source to Primary prayer time source and made the selected City Mode profile override device location on both Home and Prayer Times, including the monthly timetable.

Added private client-side .xlsx imports for complete Gregorian yearly prayer calendars. City Mode supports the Chennai All Days format, simpler standard columns, separate Shafi/Hanafi Asr and Isha values, profile duplication, previews, Deep Search generation, and calendar/text exports.

Masjid Mode can now link a City Mode Athan preset while retaining separate Iqama and Jumu’ah data. More now places City Mode above Salah Tracker, and Need Help includes a photo-to-Excel workflow, reusable AI prompt, required columns, and verification warning.

title: Location, calendar, and Quran reliability update
summary: Unified Home, Settings, and Simple Qibla around coordinate-based reverse geocoding so country selection follows the device location instead of the browser language. Deep Search Athan now applies the searched country's calculation method and madhab before generating times, and Saved Cities is now presented as City Mode.

Moved Quran Settings to a separate screen, added a daily Ayah with translation, persistent read-state highlighting, and a five-Ayah translation preview. Reworked offline Quran downloads to resume missing files through Cache Storage with retries instead of repeatedly filling localStorage.

Added a Settings preference for showing a selected City Mode timetable on Home, including a clear Saved City location label and the city's signed prayer corrections. Replaced device-dependent Hijri era formatting with an embedded Islamic civil calendar so Android consistently shows Safar and AH, and refreshed the daily and monthly Prayer Times screens to match the current navy and teal interface.

Restored the original Advanced Qibla north marker, made Settings status notices dismiss automatically, restored the full human-written Vision and copyright details, and added the explicit No Ads privacy promise.

title: A clearer, more connected Athan PWA
summary: Added Auto prayer calculation with an offline country profile for method, Asr timing, and high-latitude defaults, while keeping full manual control. Settings now follows the dark navy and teal interface, official language choices are English and Arabic with RTL support, and PWA status shares one safe install and update system with Credits.

Moved Deep Search Athan under More, separated Iqama Times, added saved-city generation and signed prayer corrections, introduced a compact current-prayer card and guided App Guide, and refined Simple and Advanced Qibla markers.

Rebuilt Quran around Quick Access, Continue Reading, recent Surah progress, search, working bookmark clearing, offline controls, and focused Muhammad Asad, Pickthall, Saheeh International, and Yusuf Ali translation previews. Credits navigation now returns correctly, Vision links to the official website and GitHub, and release notes are maintained in this JSON file.

title: Unified app update
summary: Version v3.0.0 brings major improvements across Athan PWA, including Saved Cities and Travel Mode, automatic country-based prayer settings, manual prayer corrections, smarter Quran progress, Quran offline support controls, improved Qibla modes and calibration guidance, Masjid and Iqama integration, expanded calendar and timetable exports, Salah insights, Friday Jumu'ah updates, PWA improvements, visual consistency, performance optimization, and bug fixes.

Some advanced Quran study features, such as bundled Tafsir, word-by-word data, and recitation providers, now have safe UI structure but still need real datasets or provider configuration in a future update.

title: PWA, Iqama calendar, and language foundations
summary: Refreshed the PWA icon set with proper install, maskable, Apple touch, and favicon assets. Added a Credits page Update button so users can clear the app shell cache and reload the latest deployed version without deleting local settings or tracker data.

Added Iqama calendar export for local device prayer times, including date ranges, included-prayer controls, fixed-time and Athan-offset rules, and optional Friday morning Jumu'ah reminders. The local Prayer Times screen now shows Jumu'ah instead of Dhuhr on Fridays as a display-only label.
Started basic language preference support for core navigation and prayer labels, saved privately on the device for future translation expansion.

title: Iqama Times update
summary: Added early Iqama Times support inside Advanced Athan. Users can now set Iqama rules for each prayer using either minutes after Athan or a fixed time, with AM/PM and 24-hour display options. This feature is still being improved and currently focuses on local device prayer times.

title: Version milestone and URL update
summary: Reached a new update milestone with version v2.01.1. The public app URL/domain is being updated so the app can move away from the older test link and use a cleaner release address.

title: Advanced Athan improvements
summary: Added support for searching locations, previewing prayer times, choosing calculation settings, and exporting custom calendar reminder files for selected date ranges.

title: Location and timezone handling
summary: Improved searched-location handling so Advanced Athan can better display prayer times for different cities and countries instead of relying only on the user's current device location.

title: Calendar reminder export
summary: Updated the custom .ics export experience so users can create calendar reminders for a chosen location, calculation method, Madhab, reminder offset, and date range.
